name: student-job-portal
description: Student Job Portal MERN Stack Application

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run install-all && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('client/dist')) { fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); }"
